messages:
alex: Quick heads up — HUGE congrats to @kate who just got promoted to Senior Staff Engineer!! :tada: :tada:
kate: wait what!!! 😭 thank youuuu everyone. this honestly made my day.
sam: omg congrats @kate!!! we should get pizza and a tiny cake?
maria: yes pizza + cake is mandatory. also can we keep it low-key — surprise on Monday at 12:15?
oliver: i'll bring confetti poppers and a playlist. coming in with the 'victory bops' playlist. :headphones:
lia: dietary prefs? i can do GF slices and a vegan pie. @kate any dislikes?
kate: i love everything but i avoid mushrooms. also vegan is totally cool, thanks y'all 💕
alex: perfect. @bot-pantry can you do an order for 3 large (1 vegan, 1 gf, 1 classic) + small cake?
bot-pantry: Order queued: /order 3xLarge (1 vegan, 1 gluten-free, 1 pepperoni) + 1xSmall vanilla cake. ETA 12:05–12:20. Order #45281.
maria: putting a reminder on the calendar for Monday 12:15 in the kitchen area. I'll text the team 15 min before.
sam: i'm in charge of the banner. who has a printer for tiny confetti letters?
oliver: i do! also bringing camera for embarrassing applause pics.
alex: awesome. team, try to be around the kitchen at 12:10 so we can get the surprise ready.
kate: you sneaky humans. i'll be suspicious now but also very excited. thank you so much 😭💖
maria: congrats again @kate!! cake emoji :cake: :sparkles:
lia: congrats!! can't wait to celebrate 🎉
sam: extremely well deserved. proud of you!!
alex: note: anyone with strong feelings about anchovy/banana on pizza — please file a formal complaint now so we can veto. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
maria: anchovies are banned. noted.
bot-pantry: Reminder scheduled for 15 minutes before event.
kate: already feeling spoiled. see you all Monday ✨
(reacted :tada: by sam, maria, oliver)
